==Description==
The '''Necromancer's Tome''' is an event consumable that can be obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]]. When used, it will cause [[Necromancer]]'s units to spawn from the entrance for every killed enemy.

The '''Necromancer's Tome''' can be used two times by a player in a single match. It has a 60 second cooldown, but when the match starts, it is set to 45.

==Usage==
When using the '''Necromancer's Tome''', the player will pull out the [[Necromancer]]'s tome and hold it in their hands. They will then be given the option to cast a spell on any area, though this is purely visual as the area selected has no impact on the skeletons spawned.

After being used, any enemy killed by most sources will turn into a skeleton unit that will appear from the entrance. These can be:
*The [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]], with a 70% chance.
*The [[Sword Skeleton]], with a 20% chance.
*The [[Skeleton Knight]], with a 5% chance.
*The [[Giant Skeleton (Unit)|Giant Skeleton]], with a 2% chance.
*The [[Hallow Guard (Unit)|Hallow Guard]], with a 2% chance.
*The [[Executioner Skeleton]], with a 1% chance.

While most sources of damage can summon them, there are certain ways of dealing damage which will not create skeletons:
*Damage from [[Cryomancer]]'s chillness is completely unable to generate skeletons.
*Units, regardless if from the '''Necromancer's Tome''' or a tower, cannot summon skeletons.
*Consumables like the [[Grenade]] are incapable of creating skeletons.

==Appearance==
The '''Necromancer's Tome''' is a tome with a skull on its front.

==Strategy==
*The '''Necromancer's Tome''' is best used on waves that contain multiple easy to kill enemies.
**Summoner enemies like the [[Fallen Necromancer]] are best for this, as they will keep on summoning more enemies to convert into skeletons.
***It is also possible to intentionally leave such enemies on the map as long as possible to make them generate more enemies, increasing how many skeletons you make.
*It is advised to not use this if your main source of damage comes from units, as these do not generate skeletons.
**Similarly, any damaging consumables should not be used while this is active as they cannot generate them either.
